name: Two-Finger Rotate

inputs.name: Target
inputs.description: The scene object to be rotated

inputs.name: Rotation Sensitivity
inputs.description: The rate at which a scene object rotates in relation to the fingers' movement. A higher value will rotate the object as fast as the fingers, while a negative value will rotate the object in the reverse direction of the finger. Value range: -10 to 10

description: Rotates a scene object when two fingers pinch the screen and rotate
